transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I guess I'm here because of my eating. What really brings me in is that... well, after I do it, I just sit there looking at all the empty containers and wrappers, and I feel completely disgusted with myself. I've always tried to be a steady, in-control kind of man, but when I'm sitting there looking at what I just did, I feel like I'm not that man at all anymore.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Yeah, I do. Some evenings I’ll heat up what I swear is just one bowl of pozole, and before I know it... I’ve gone through the whole pot. Then I'll have a couple tamales, a bag of chips, and whatever leftovers are sitting in the fridge. It's like I’m feeding a whole crew instead of just myself.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you eat?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Once I start, it feels like... I don't know, the same discipline I have when I'm driving on the road just completely shuts off. It's like my brain is telling me, "Magin, put the fork down, you're done," but my hand just keeps going back for more. I just can't seem to stop it once it starts.
After you eat this way, do you do anything to try to undo it, like making yourself vomit?
No, I don't do anything like that. I don't throw up or take any pills or anything to try and get rid of it. I just sit there feeling full and bad about it.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?

Yeah, they really do. Honestly, that's what brings me in to see you. After I do it, I just... I sit there looking at all the empty containers, and I feel completely disgusted with myself. I've always tried to be a steady, in-control kind of man. But sitting there after eating all that, feeling that way... it just makes me feel like I'm not that man at all. It really gets to me.
How often do these binge-eating episodes happen?

Well, since I've been stuck at home with this back injury, it's been happening pretty often. I'd say several nights most weeks. Honestly, I can't think of a single week in the last three months where I didn't have at least one of those episodes.
